questions: What can I do on this website
answer: FreshFind is a fruit and farm-produce guide where you can explore different fruits, learn about them, discover where they come from, and find out what may be available around Lagos.
You can explore fruits such as mangoes, bananas, pineapples, pawpaw, watermelon, oranges, avocado, coconut, guava, passion fruit, apples, grapes, strawberries, and many more.

questions: Which fruits are found in Nigeria
answer: Common fruits found in Nigeria include mangoes, bananas, plantains, pineapples, pawpaw, watermelon, oranges, tangerines, guava, coconut, avocado, passion fruit, and seasonal fruits such as agbalumo.

questions: What fruit can grow in Lagos
What fruits are grown in Lagos
answer: Fruits that can be grown in Lagos and surrounding areas include pawpaw, pineapple, watermelon, banana, plantain, coconut, guava and some citrus fruits. Lagos also receives fruit from farms in other parts of Nigeria.

questions: Can you tell me about mango
answer: Mangoes are tropical fruits with juicy, sweet flesh and a large seed. Nigeria grows several mango varieties, and mangoes become especially noticeable in markets during their main harvest periods.

questions: Can you tell me about banana
answer: Bananas are soft, naturally sweet fruits that grow in bunches. They are widely available in Nigeria and can be eaten fresh or used in smoothies, baking and cooking.

questions: Can you tell me about plantain
answer: Plantain is closely related to banana but is commonly cooked before eating. It can be fried, boiled, roasted, or prepared in many Nigerian dishes.

questions: Can you tell me about pineapple
answer: Pineapples are tropical fruits with rough outer skin and juicy sweet-tart flesh. They are grown in several parts of Nigeria and are commonly sold in Lagos markets.

questions: Can you tell me about pawpaw
answer: Pawpaw, also known as papaya, is a tropical fruit with soft orange or yellow flesh and many black seeds. It is commonly grown and sold in Nigeria.

questions: Can you tell me about watermelon
answer: Watermelon has juicy flesh and a thick green rind. It contains a lot of water and is especially popular during hot weather.

questions: Can you tell me about orange
answer: Oranges are citrus fruits with juicy segments and a refreshing sweet or slightly sour flavor. They are commonly sold throughout Nigeria.

questions: Can you tell me about avocado
answer: Avocado is a fruit with creamy flesh surrounding a large seed. In Nigeria it is often called pear and can be eaten fresh or added to meals.

questions: Can you tell me about coconut
answer: Coconut comes from the coconut palm and contains coconut water and white flesh. Coconut is especially familiar in coastal areas and is widely used in Nigerian food and drinks.

questions: Can you tell me about guava
answer: Guava is a fragrant fruit that can have green or yellow skin and white or pink flesh. It contains many small edible seeds.

questions: Can you tell me about passion fruit
answer: Passion fruit has a tough outer skin and juicy aromatic pulp containing many small edible seeds. Its flavor is strongly sweet and tart.

questions: Tell me about African star apple
answer: Agbalumo, also called African star apple, is a seasonal fruit popular in Nigeria. It has a distinctive sweet and tangy flavor and is usually associated with a particular period of the year.

questions: Is tomato a fruit or vegetable
answer: Yes. Botanically, a tomato is a fruit because it develops from a flower and contains seeds. In cooking, however, it is usually treated as a vegetable.

Citrus fruits include oranges, lemons, limes, grapefruits, mandarins and tangerines.
There is no single fruit that is always the sweetest because sweetness depends on the variety and ripeness. Ripe mangoes, grapes, dates and some melons can be very sweet.

questions: What is the difference between fruit and vegetable
What's the difference between fruits and vegetables
How are fruits different from vegetables
answer: Botanically, a fruit develops from the flower of a plant and usually contains seeds. Vegetables are other edible plant parts such as roots, stems and leaves. Cooking uses these categories differently.

questions: Why do fruits have different colors
answer: Fruit colors come from natural pigments such as chlorophyll, carotenoids and anthocyanins. These pigments can become more visible as fruits develop and ripen.
Many fruits contain natural sugars. During ripening, some fruits convert stored starches into sugars, which can make them taste sweeter.
Sourness usually comes from organic acids naturally present in fruits. Citrus fruits, for example, contain citric acid.

questions: What fruits are currently in season
answer: Fruit seasons vary across Nigeria. Mangoes and agbalumo have noticeable seasonal periods, while fruits such as bananas and pawpaw can be available for much longer depending on farming conditions and supply.
Mangoes are generally associated with the dry-season to early-rainy-season harvest period in Nigeria, although timing can vary by variety and location.
Agbalumo is a seasonal fruit in Nigeria and is typically seen in markets during its harvest period rather than throughout the entire year.
Farms can produce fruits, vegetables, grains, roots, tubers and other crops. Fruit farms may grow mangoes, pawpaw, pineapple, citrus, banana, plantain and other crops.
Fruit plants can be grown from seeds, cuttings or grafted plants depending on the species. Farmers manage soil, water, nutrients, pests and harvesting to produce healthy crops.

questions: Does mango grow on a tree
answer: Mangoes grow on trees. The trees produce flowers that develop into mango fruits after successful pollination.

questions: Does pineapple grow on a tree
answer: Pineapples grow as low plants rather than on trees. A pineapple develops from many flowers that join together into one compound fruit.

questions: Does banana grow on a tree
answer: Bananas grow from large herbaceous plants rather than traditional woody trees. The plant produces a bunch of bananas from a flowering structure.

questions: Where do fruits in Lagos come from
answer: Fruits sold in Lagos can come from farms in Lagos State and from farming regions across Nigeria. Produce is transported through traders and major distribution markets before reaching shops and consumers.

questions: Where do farmers take their produce
answer: Farmers may sell through farm-gate buyers, wholesalers, traders, local markets, distributors or directly to customers. Large produce markets can connect farmers and traders with buyers.

questions: What happens on a fruit farm
How does a fruit farm work
answer: A fruit farm is a farm where fruit-producing plants are cultivated and managed for harvest. Depending on the farm, it might specialize in mangoes, citrus, pineapple, pawpaw or several crops.
Farm produce refers to crops and other products produced by farms. This can include fruits, vegetables, grains, roots, tubers and other agricultural products.
Mile 12 Market in Lagos is a major fresh-produce trading hub. It is known for large quantities of fruits, vegetables and other agricultural products arriving from different parts of Nigeria.

questions: What can I buy at Oyingbo
answer: Oyingbo is a well-known food market area on Lagos Mainland where shoppers can find many types of food and fresh produce.
You can buy fruit from neighbourhood markets, roadside fruit sellers, supermarkets, produce shops and larger food markets across Lagos.
Mangoes can be found at fruit sellers, neighbourhood markets and larger produce markets when they are in supply. Availability changes during the year.

questions: What is the price of fruit
answer: Fruit prices change frequently in Lagos depending on the fruit, season, size, quality, location and supply. Check the current seller price before buying.

questions: Why does fruit cost so much
answer: Fruit prices can increase when supply is low, transport costs rise, weather affects farms, or a fruit is outside its main harvest period.

questions: How do I know if a mango is ripe
How can I tell if mango is ripe
How do I check a mango
When is mango ready to eat
answer: A ripe mango often gives slightly when gently pressed and may have a pleasant fruity smell. Color alone is not always reliable because mango varieties differ.

questions: How do I know if pawpaw is ripe
How can I tell if pawpaw is ripe
When is pawpaw ready to eat
answer: A ripe pawpaw usually becomes softer and develops more yellow or orange color on the skin. It should not have major signs of spoilage.

questions: How can I keep bananas fresh
answer: Keep bananas at room temperature while they ripen. Refrigeration can slow further ripening once they are ripe, although the peel may become darker.

questions: How can I keep mangoes fresh
answer: Unripe mangoes can be kept at room temperature until they ripen. Once ripe, refrigeration can help slow further ripening.

questions: How do I cut a mango
How can I cut a mango
answer: Wash the mango, cut along both sides of the large flat seed, score the flesh into pieces without cutting through the skin, then scoop the pieces away from the skin.

questions: How do I cut a pineapple
How can I cut a pineapple
answer: Remove the top and bottom, stand the pineapple upright, carefully remove the outer skin, then cut the flesh away from the tough central core.

questions: What fruit has the most water
Which fruit has the most water
What fruit contains lots of water
answer: Watermelon is famous for its very high water content. Strawberries, oranges and grapefruit also contain a lot of water.
Oranges and other citrus fruits contain vitamin C. Guava, kiwi and strawberries are also notable sources.

questions: What fruit is good for smoothies
What fruits are good for smoothies
Which fruit can I use in a smoothie
What fruit should I put in a smoothie
answer: Banana, mango, pineapple, pawpaw, strawberries and other soft fruits can work well in smoothies.

questions: What can I mix with mango
answer: Mango pairs well with pineapple, banana, passion fruit, oranges, strawberries and lime.

questions: Can I eat fruit every day
Is it okay to eat fruit every day
Should I eat fruit every day
answer: Fruit can be part of a varied and balanced diet. Eating different fruits provides a wider range of nutrients.
Fruit can provide fiber, vitamins, minerals, water and other naturally occurring compounds. Different fruits provide different nutrients.

questions: What fruit is the best for health
answer: There is no single fruit that is universally the healthiest. Different fruits provide different combinations of nutrients.
